parsed.notes: Reviewed all five assertion_ids under Lens B only; no external sources used.

reasons: Lake record is verified and identifies the case as Florida v. Powell, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 2010-02-23, docket 08-1175.
Lake citations include the official citation 559 U.S. 50, the parallel citations 130 S. Ct. 1195 and 175 L. Ed. 2d 1009, and vendor-neutral citation 2010 U.S. LEXIS 1898.
Lake treatment marks the authority good_law as of 2026-06-30.
residual_risks: Treatment derivation contains an unresolved top-cited audit marker, but that does not undermine identity/existence on the disclosed record.

reasons: Lens B does not evaluate the home-role support merits.
No disclosed currency or treatment field makes the role unusable: the lake record is verified, SCOTUS, and marked good_law as of 2026-06-30.
The progeny section reports indexed citing opinions and citation_count, consistent with treating Powell as progeny/refinement in the Miranda line from a currency perspective.
residual_risks: Role fit remains a Lens A/support question.

reasons: Lens B does not evaluate holding support or quote fidelity.
From the treatment/currency angle, the lake scope_note matches the same current-law point: good law; Miranda warnings are invariable in substance but need not be conveyed in precise words.
No disclosed point_override or confirmed negative treatment limits this proposition.
residual_risks: Holding support and verbatim accuracy remain for Lens A.

defect.locator_note: treatment field and Treatment & subsequent history section
defect.problem: The good_law label itself matches the lake top-level treatment, but the page's categorical no-negative-treatment framing is too strong for the disclosed record because the treatment derivation still has an unresolved top-cited audit marker and proposed treatment edges.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep field_i_validity: good_law, but tighten the treatment prose to say there is no confirmed negative treatment in the disclosed lake record and that the automated/top-cited treatment audit remains marked R15/audit-needed.

reasons: Lake top-level treatment says field_i_validity is good_law, as_of_treatment is 2026-06-30, varies_by_point is false, and point_overrides is empty.
All 27 disclosed treatment edges have field_iii set to mentioned, so no edge confirms that Powell itself was overruled, abrogated, superseded, or limited.
However, lane2_top_cited has cap_hit true, audit_needed true, and audit_marker R15 treatment audit required, so categorical no-negative wording overstates the disclosed treatment certainty.
residual_risks: A CourtListener/top-cited audit would be needed to clear the R15 marker and remove the proposed-edge uncertainty.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use: "No confirmed negative treatment in the disclosed lake record; top-cited automated treatment audit remains marked R15/audit-needed."

reasons: The authority_weight label Binding — SCOTUS matches the lake identity fields: court U.S. Supreme Court and court_level scotus.
The lake treatment field marks Powell good_law as of 2026-06-30, with no point overrides lowering the weight of the cited federal Miranda proposition.
residual_risks: The binding label assumes the page is using Powell for the federal constitutional Miranda issue, which is the disclosed scope.
